name: zanker-quality-benchmark
description: Evaluate Zanker with reproducible UX/UI tasks across frameworks and scenarios.

workflow.instruction: Select representative tasks: broken mobile modal, form error, dashboard redesign, new marketing page, shared component regression.
Prepare fixed fixture, source baseline, rubric and screenshot configuration.
Have human judge independently score product suitability, visuals, usability and maintainability.
Compare failure rates and regressions across agent revisions, not only average aesthetic score.

acceptance: All claims backed by test results
fallback: Use small curated task suite and mark low statistical confidence.
